issues.negative-litres: The Record past watering form on /beds and POST /api/waterings accept a negative amount such as -5 litres, save it, report success, and list it as a negative amount on /waterings.
issues.water-now-twice: Double-clicking the Water now button on /beds sends two POST /api/waterings requests and records two identical waterings because the button stays enabled while its request runs.
issues.waterings-page-load-error-no-retry: When GET /api/waterings fails on /waterings, only the error text is shown with no retry control, so the user must reload the page.
issues.dashboard-invalid-response-shown-as-empt: When GET /api/waterings?limit=5 returns an empty object instead of a list, the dashboard Recent waterings card shows the 'No waterings yet' empty state instead of an error.
issues.waterings-page-crash-non-list-response: When GET /api/waterings returns a non-array body (malformed or empty object), /waterings throws an uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function' and never renders, leaving the previous page on screen with no error.
issues.dashboard-waterings-error-no-retry: When the dashboard Recent waterings request fails, the card shows only the error text with no retry control.
issues.tiny-litres-shown-as-zero: Recording a past watering of a tiny amount such as 0.004 L on /beds is accepted despite the field's 0.1 minimum and is reported and listed as '0 L'.
issues.year-one-date-accepted: The Record past watering form on /beds and POST /api/waterings accept an absurd date such as 0001-01-01, save it with 201, and report 'Recorded 2 L on 1 Jan 1.'.
issues.dashboard-malformed-response-renders-gar: When GET /api/waterings?limit=5 returns a malformed non-list body, the dashboard Recent waterings table renders rows reading 'Never', a blank bed, and '–' instead of an error.
issues.water-now-shared-busy-state-across-beds: On /beds, clicking Water now on two beds in quick succession re-enables the second bed's button when the first request finishes because a single shared wateringBedId tracks the in-flight request, and the first bed's notice is lost.
issues.unknown-bed-filter-select-mismatch: Opening /waterings?bed=99999 with an unknown bed id filters the list to 'No waterings for this bed' while the Bed select shows no selection, so the select and list disagree.
